body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Sharp demonstrated a 7 mega-pixel camera ''IR Simple'' with IrSS receiver during CES 2007.

It can transmit HD data to photo printer to print out directly as well as transfer the image to TV or PC directly. It takes about one second to deliver one image from the camera to TV and it prints less than in one minute. The ‘IR Simple'' is also easy to use without the need of cable, PC and card slot.
This model is expected to be announced this February in Japan first and will be available in US market from this second quarter of 2007 for MSRP of $399.
